description: A pipeline-bar row is green when all seven properties are present and an orchestrator bridge is explicitly baselined.

pipeline_bar.orchestrator_exception: GitHub required-check adapter remains the live bridge until oya-ci emits native GateRun statuses.

orchestrator_exception_baseline.cutover: P0.0 oya-ci native GateRun required-status cutover
orchestrator_exception_baseline.reason: GitHub Actions required-check bridge is live merge admission while the cloud-ci/oya-ci controller surface reaches P0.0.

rows.requirement: Pipeline gates must satisfy the ADR-0548 seven-property bar, and any orchestrator exception must be baselined.
